lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense matrix of high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with inter-cluster spacing approximately 1.5 to 2 times the diameter of individual blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a geometric grid where blobs function as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two remoras visible as elongated silhouettes attached to the mid-lateral and posterior-lateral flank surface.
